egress.terms: Not metered separately on the free tier.

tooling: Gradient notebooks/CLI; persistent storage is a mounted `/storage` volume shared across notebooks on the account.
chaining: 5 GB x N accounts. Too small to matter; the next tiers (15 GB, 50 GB) are paid or trial.
limits_note: 'Auto-shutdown (12 hour limit)'; free machines are C1-class; notebooks must be public on the free tier; 1 running notebook.

reliability_note: Stable and long-running, but 5 GB is 1% of a user's minimum and there is no free path upward.
